name: prabhg-plugins
description: Prabhh's curated Claude Code plugins and skills, installable on any machine.

plugins.name: fokus
plugins.description: Action-first output shaping: next action first, numbered steps, no tangents, visible progress.

plugins.name: tidy-workspace
plugins.description: End-of-session workspace cleanup: stale worktrees, merged branches, disk caches, temp handoff docs, and agent memory — discover, print targets, confirm, act one at a time, verify.

plugins.name: architecture-share-doc
plugins.description: Build a single-file HTML architecture review doc for a team: layered system map, one pre-rendered sequence diagram per user action, services and ownership, APIs by domain, tiers, access rules, environments, security, rollout and decisions.

plugins.name: project-planning-repo
plugins.description: Set up and maintain a private project/ delivery-planning repo (branch planning) beside a multi-repo project: cross-repo ARCHITECTURE + BACKLOG, temp handoffs with clean-when headers, closed-ticket archive, sync-on-fetch and never-referenced-from-repos rules, optional GitHub Issues tracking, periodic 7-day treeshake of memory, temp/, local/ and docs.

plugins.name: autonomous-orchestrator
plugins.description: Run long unattended multi-agent builds from one session: lean-context orchestrator, tickets with DoD, cheapest-capable subagents in worktrees, review before every merge, wave merges to dev, green builds, cleanup, one resumable state file with handover/takeover.

plugins.name: account-handoff
plugins.description: Carry a project across Claude account logins on one machine: before switching, capture work in flight, live sessions, git state and everything tied to the account into a local handoff; after switching, verify, re-prime and resume. Any number of accounts, repeated round trips.
